rules.sentence: Differential diagnoses of meningioma include those lesions that are dural-based, have a dural tail, and have a homogenous enhancement.[62]
Adjuvant therapies might be required to reduce the recurrence rate in incompletely removed meningiomas and atypical or malignant meningiomas.

The use of bevacizumab, a type of chemotherapy to target molecular alterations of vascular endothelial growth factor in patients with anaplastic meningiomas after surgical resection and radiotherapy, had shown successful results of tumor regression.[61]
